Making real response
decisions with production
data access?

Log it, monitor it,
revisit next audit cycle

span.p:
Underlying complaint is a
real central-SOC service gap
(speed, domain expertise, coverage)?

span.p:
Absorb: onboard the tool
and data source into the
central SIEM, retire the shadow path

span.p:
Federate: charter a formal
local role feeding the central
SOC, amend the Part 4 RACI

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Update charter, RACI,
and asset inventory

Shut down with no fix
